title: bridge-lease-contract-and-unified-async-iterator-specification
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Inconsistent token lifecycle semantics and streaming ergonomics across SDKs caused production races (token TTL mismatch, redundant reconnects, flaky resume behavior). This PR standardizes a minimal credential contract (TTL, refresh window, optional delegated refresh callback), introduces a compact Lease API (Lease.acquire/renew/release) and a unified StreamV2 async-iterator/pull-generator surface with explicit resume checkpoints, backpressure hints, and a cancelable shutdown helper, and synchronizes retry preset names (fast/balanced/defensive) plus coordinated version bumps. The change includes runtime conversion shims for legacy credential providers with deprecation warnings and preserves v1 surfaces under legacy module paths for one release. Scope: implement contract checks and runtime warnings, add Lease in py/ts/go, implement StreamV2 consumer and shutdown orchestration across tri-SDK, align retry preset plumbing, update examples, tests, changelogs and publish scripts. Impact: fixes SUP-9123 token-expiry reconnect storms and improves streaming consumer ergonomics for clients that implement persistent resume or local checkpointing. Migration: see docs/sdk/migration/credential-contract.md and examples; simple adapter snippet included in docs for converting legacy providers.
